summary: A modern neutral. This sophisticated, cool-toned dusty rose lipstick offers a chic, creamy finish that perfectly complements any look.
technical_overview: Offered at $28.0 for 3.5g, this KoColor LIPSTICK is expertly formulated with Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Shea Butter, Titanium Dioxide, Iron Oxides, Blue 1 Lake. Delivering a high-fidelity Concrete Rose color profile (`#9F8D85`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
